Lead revenue (30 days)AED 64,300Auctions + fixed-price unlocks

How auctions work

  1. A verified lead opens a sealed auction for vendors whose verified listings match the service and emirate.
  2. Bids start at the floor price. Ranking = bid × quality score (rating, response time, win-to-quote rate).
  3. The top winners (usually 3) receive the contact details. Each pays just above the next-ranked bid — never more than their own bid, never below the floor.
  4. No bids by closing time → the lead is released at the floor price to matching vendors, first come first served.
  5. Customers never see bids. Invalid leads are refunded to the vendor wallet within 48 hours.
